description: safwanyp.com is a personal website for Safwan Parkar that publishes read-only machine-readable discovery endpoints for site search, feeds, API catalog metadata, agent skills, and MCP access.
summary: Public integration surface consists of one read-only HTTP/OpenAPI API at https://safwanyp.com with spec at /openapi.json, plus a public MCP server at https://safwanyp.com/mcp using streamable HTTP; no authentication is documented for either.
